operational_contrasts.difference: These add navigation, broad-family/analogy exploration, issue tracing, scouts or a shared inventory. B11 changes the next-question selector: relevant already-retrieved evidence outside the current answered question/account seeds at most two new governing-source inquiries. No new investigator, analogue lens, historical answer or task-level discovery sharing.

operational_contrasts.nearest_prior: ER11 M09 / STORM analogue outline interviews
operational_contrasts.difference: Old inquiry lenses are generated from related-topic structures and answered in separate investigators; B11 takes unused evidence already returned by its own lookup and selects a relevant new question outside the answered query. One investigator, no lens/interview topology.

operational_contrasts.nearest_prior: ER11 M10 / PaperQA2 question relevance reformulation
operational_contrasts.difference: M10 ranks passages by how well they answer a predeclared question and re-queries missing conditions. B11 deliberately uses relevant information outside that direct answer to originate a new mechanism question; no evidence-card scoring/selection queue.

operational_contrasts.nearest_prior: ER11 M12 adaptive evidence state branching
operational_contrasts.difference: M12 reallocates future search slots using hand-scored changes in support states. B11 neither scores information gain nor reallocates across branches; it has one bounded unused-evidence pivot inside ordinary discovery.
These reorganize consequential verification/breadth/freshness challenges. B11 changes discovery question provenance before exact-plan reveal, while criticism and finalization remain ordinary R0.

conclusion: B11 is a small new campaign intervention, not an external algorithm invention: source-unused evidence selects a new inquiry before plan reveal. It is distinct from inspected compact menu mechanisms. Efficacy is prospective and unknown.
